## Open

### F-579 — sport: model.md and rules.md disagree

> _2026-10-23 · realm/blong-sport · open_

The two source documents for the sport realm were written independently. model.md has no sports
category object although rules.md requires categories to come from a classifier, and rules.md
requires three separate records for qualification, quota and right of participation where model.md
describes one object with a quota field. Both cost a clarification round before the schema could be
planned; treat any future model.md change as a candidate for the same comparison.

### F-580 — sport: teams and rosters are deferred

> _2026-10-23 · realm/blong-sport · open_

Team participation is not modelled in this POC. participation.teamName and
qualification.quotaRecipientKind carry the individual, partner and team cases, and rules.md VII.5
asks for a link to the team and its composition. The follow-up is a sport.team resource plus a
roster table with from and to dates; do not add team members ad hoc to a participation row in the
meantime.

### F-581 — sport: party test seeds require the gateway realm

> _2026-10-23 · realm/blong-sport · open_

Attaching blong-party brings its meta/dbTest ACL-matrix seeds, and those grant a gateway application
its scope. In a suite without the gateway realm the merge handler is missing, the call falls through
to a generic merge, and the boot dies with rows.map is not a function on the bundle object. Attach
gateway wherever party is attached.

### F-582 — sport: table order is dependency order

> _2026-10-23 · realm/blong-sport · open_

The constraint pass walks schema.tables in order, so a table listed before the table its foreign key
names fails with Missing index for constraint in the referenced table and no primary key is applied.
Listing the classifiers first and the profiles after them fixed it; the dev database had to be
dropped because the partial sync left tables without keys.

### F-583 — sport: custom CRUD must encode binary ids

> _2026-10-23 · realm/blong-sport · open_

A hand-written find or get returns raw knex rows, so binary(16) columns reach the client as Buffer
objects and match nothing; the generic CRUD runs prepareResultRows for exactly this reason. Every
value crossing a binary column must also be decoded from base64 on the way in. Both directions live
in adapter/db/profile.ts.

### F-584 — sport: seed names, exit flag and uuid marker

> _2026-10-23 · realm/blong-sport · open_

A seed asset is dispatched by its file name, so 0-sportTypeMerge.yaml asks for a sport.type table
and fails; it must be 0-coreTypeMerge.yaml. The blong exit flag does not stop the watch process, so
a boot check needs timeout plus a grep of the log. kukum is not on PATH here; run node
core/blong-kukum/bin/kukum.ts. partyPersonAdd inserts no id unless the payload carries the literal
uuid marker.

### F-586 — A custom get must answer the object root, and delete needs refresh

> _2026-10-23 · realm/blong-sport · open_

Three traps cost a full Playwright cycle each. A hand-written get that returns a bare row leaves the
edit form empty and the helper dies on waitForFormData, because the editor loadAction reads the
object root; the payload is {object: row} with each detail list as a sibling, which is what the
generic get builds. A capability names the dotted method, never the handler name, or every call
answers 403 and the seed reads as if it were ignored. A delete toolbar entry without refresh deletes
the row in the database and leaves it on the screen, so cleanup waits ten seconds for a count that
never drops; the generic remove also reads its key at the top level of the payload, so a nested
{person: {personId}} call is refused as a missing key.

### F-587 — A shared test marker and duplicate titles both stop the suite

> _2026-10-23 · realm/blong-sport · open_

Two spec-level traps cost a full suite cycle each. A cleanup that searches a short marker such as
ENT-PLAY also matches the rows another spec created in the same run, and deleting their athlete is
then refused by the participation foreign key; each spec needs its own prefix, and the cleanups must
run dependents first. Playwright also rejects a duplicated test title outright, so registering the
same cleanupModel twice in one describe fails the whole file before any test runs. A screenshot
baseline that a spec has not written yet fails that spec, so the first pass over a new spec has to
run with update-snapshots.

### F-612 — The migration job cannot create the database it must connect to

> _2026-10-27 · realm/blong-sport · open_

The plan said the seed or migration job creates the blong-sport database, so the MySQL init script
created only the user and grant. The first deploy proved the opposite: the deployed process and the
migration Job connect with database: blong-sport, and MySQL answers ER_BAD_DB_ERROR Unknown database
before the upgrade code can run. The database has to exist first. The fix is CREATE DATABASE IF NOT
EXISTS in the init script and once on the running MySQL; a suite that wants the seed job to create
its schema has to name a database that already exists or the adapter would have to connect without
one.

## Resolved

### F-585 — An overridden CRUD handler cannot delegate to the generic one

> _2026-10-23 · realm/blong-sport · resolved_

Overriding sport.conferral.add to stamp recipientKind from core_resource is impossible: the override
replaces the method it would call, and there is no way to reach the generic implementation under the
same name. The model therefore keeps recipientKind as an operator select. A pre-write hook (or a
distinct method name for the generic path) would let the derivation live in code as the model asked.

Resolved: an override reaches the generic CRUD through super.exec on the prototype chain, as
blong-access does for its ACL handlers. The kind is derived in sportConferralAdd/Edit.

### F-616 — A JSON import attribute is lost by tap's TypeScript loader

> _2026-10-27 · realm/blong-sport · resolved_

A JSON import attribute does not survive tap's TypeScript loader.
`import pkg from './package.json' with {type: 'json'}` at the top of a suite entry is green under
plain `node` (type stripping honours it) and kills the tap child with `ERR_IMPORT_ATTRIBUTE_MISSING`
— the report says only `1..0 # no tests found`, `test process exited with code 1`, and the child's
stderr is not in the artifact. `realm/blong-sport/index.ts` gained that import for
`kustomize.deploy.suite.version`, and the package's tap leg went from 172 passing tests to none
while every other package stayed green, because no other package's `index.test.ts` statically
imports an entry that reads its package.json. Use
`createRequire(import.meta.url)('./package.json')`, which is what the loader itself does for the
same file; to see the real error, run
`npx tap <file> --coverage-report=none --allow-incomplete-coverage` in the package, because the
runner's record keeps the exit code and drops the reason.

Resolved by removing the read: the sport entry no longer imports package.json at all, because the
suite version now comes from the manifest through describe().pkg (D-646). The trap is still real for
any entry that does import one under tap.
